faqs.question: How do you typically engage with a new client?
faqs.answer: We start with a free 30-minute discovery call to understand your challenges. We then propose a tailored engagement plan with clear deliverables and timelines.

faqs.question: How long does a typical project take?
faqs.answer: Projects vary from 4-week sprints (process audits) to 12-month strategic engagements. We'll recommend the right scope after understanding your goals.

faqs.question: Do you work with startups or only established businesses?
faqs.answer: Both! We have tailored programs for early-stage startups and comprehensive services for established businesses looking to scale or pivot.

faqs.question: What industries do you specialize in?
faqs.answer: We serve businesses across technology, healthcare, retail, finance, and professional services. Our frameworks are adaptable to any industry.
